title: SM exit year (2017 / 2018 / 2019)
body:
- **Claim A (2017–2018):** Money Today's recap of *You Quiz* (MHJ-SRC-000380, 2021-12-02) says she
  became 총괄이사 about fifteen years after joining in 2002 and resigned the following year;
  Xportsnews' headline (MHJ-SRC-000072) says she left one year after becoming 이사; a YouTube
  re-edit title (MHJ-SRC-000114) frames the decision as coming right after the promotion, which
  some readers take as 2017.
- **Claim B (2018 / 2019):** Asia Economy (MHJ-SRC-000379, 2024-04-25) says registered director
  in 2017 and left in 2018, "about two years" later; a 2019 Money Today profile via Wikipedia
  says end of 2018 (not read); namu.wiki gives a 2002–2019 career line (tier D, not used as
  evidence); 2019 hiring reports call her "SM 민희진 이사" and describe a move "SM에서 빅히트로"
  (MHJ-SRC-000210, -000211, -000051, all 2019-07-01).
- **Established:** joined SM 2002 (MHJ-SRC-000002); newly appointed a registered director on
  2017-03-31 (MHJ-SRC-000364, -000208); listed as "SM비주얼 아트디렉터" for a 2018-10-22 talk
  (MHJ-SRC-000366, an event listing); announced as Big Hit CBO on 2019-07-01 (MHJ-SRC-000047).
- **Unknown:** the actual exit date; whether the October 2018 listing reflects current or past
  affiliation; DART officer tables for 2017 and 2018 (not read). No contemporaneous departure
  report was found (search-log MHJ-SRCH-00150).
- **Candidate explanations:** "the next year" after a March 2017 appointment fits a late-2018 exit;
  2019 hiring headlines may name her last employer rather than a direct transfer; event listings
  and profiles lag; recaps paraphrase a TV conversation.
- **Affects the creative model?** No. It moves the E3/E4 boundary (protocol §5a puts the exit in
  E3, ending 2019-06), not any principle.
- **Status:** open. Settle with DART officer lists or a dated SM statement.

title: Her university major as reported
body:
- **Claim A:** OSEN 2013 (MHJ-SRC-000002, MHJ-EV-00013) has her trained in popular art (reported
  as 대중 미술 전공).
- **Claim B:** her own account in the Cuvism interview (fan translation, MHJ-SRC-000262,
  MHJ-EV-00491) says she majored in visual design; Maeil Shinmun 2019 (MHJ-SRC-000210) gives
  visual design at Seoul Women's University; 2018 Yonhap Q&A calls her a design graduate
  (MHJ-EV-00001).
- **Established:** a design degree; album-cover coursework as an art student (MHJ-EV-00255);
  internship at an advertising agency during university (MHJ-EV-00256, -00491).
- **Unknown:** whether "popular art" was a course name, a concentration, or the reporter's
  phrasing; the Cuvism original (not located).
- **Candidate explanations:** reporter's loose wording; her own description of her training's aim
  (popular art as mass communication, cf. MHJ-EV-00258) read as a degree name; translation.
- **Affects the creative model?** No.
- **Status:** resolved by record for "visual design" (one self-account, medium; one profile, C);
  OSEN wording left as reported.

title: SM title wording over time
body:
- **Claim A:** 2013 press uses 비주얼 & 아트(디렉팅) 실장 (MHJ-SRC-000352, -000355, -000002);
  월간디자인 2013 calls her head of visual planning (MHJ-SRC-000195).
- **Claim B:** the same year, SM's own release calls her the art director in charge of concept
  planning (MHJ-SRC-000356); Wikipedia dates "creative director" to 2012; a 2016 showcase quote
  calls her 이사 (MHJ-SRC-000360) a year before her board appointment; MAMA 2016 reports
  "아트디렉터 … 본부장" (MHJ-SRC-000361); a 2018 listing says "visual art director"
  (MHJ-SRC-000366).
- **Established:** sequence in `projects/roles-and-attribution.md` §3: 과장 (c. 2010, recollection) →
  팀장 (2011–2012) → 실장 (2013–2014) → 디렉터 / creative director (2015–2017) → 이사 (2016 usage) →
  본부장 (2016-12) → registered director, head of art direction (2017-03-31). Earliest standalone
  "Creative Director" credit found: f(x) *Electric Shock* 2012 (Discogs, not re-verified).
- **Unknown:** official internal titles and dates; whether 이사 in 2016 was a non-registered
  executive title.
- **Candidate explanations:** rank titles, office names and press labels coexist; Korean
  in-house titles (실장, 본부장) map loosely onto English "director"; outlets reuse older titles.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes, for attribution wording only: write "headed SM's visual &
  art directing office" or "creative director" per date, not one title for 2002–2019.
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent (rank, office and press label differ in the same year).

title: Registered-director status and "총괄이사"
body:
- **Claim A:** 연합뉴스 and 이투데이 report her newly appointed 등기이사 with the portfolio
  아트디렉트 총괄 on 2017-03-31 (MHJ-SRC-000364, -000208).
- **Claim B:** later coverage mostly says 이사 or 총괄이사 (MHJ-SRC-000380); "registered director"
  and "first female director" recur in profiles without a filing.
- **Established:** the 2017-03-31 appointment as reported by two contemporaneous outlets.
- **Unknown:** DART confirmation; the "first female director" claim found no support (secondary-
  contradiction notes, myth 3).
- **Candidate explanations:** 총괄이사 conflates the portfolio (총괄) with the rank (이사).
- **Affects the creative model?** No.
- **Status:** open (filing not read). Do not repeat "first female director".

title: Put-option ruling date (12 vs 13 Feb 2026)
body:
- **Claim A:** 12 Feb 2026 — Newspim full statement (MHJ-SRC-000169), Korea Herald
  (MHJ-SRC-000395), Korea JoongAng Daily (-000396), Munhwa Ilbo (-000397), Forbes (-000254);
  chronology entry 2026-02-12.
- **Claim B:** 13 Feb — The Korea Times, 2026-02-25 (MHJ-SRC-000255), per its triage note.
- **Established:** first-instance ruling by Seoul Central District Court, Civil Agreement Division
  31, reported by five outlets on 12 Feb with same-day statements from her label.
- **Unknown:** the court's own record (not read).
- **Candidate explanations:** a dating slip; conflation with the producers' association statement
  of 13 Feb (MHJ-SRC-000398); a US-time dateline.
- **Affects the creative model?** No.
- **Status:** resolved by record as reported (12 Feb); the court record was not consulted.

title: First meeting with the Casa BRUTUS editor (2024 vs March 2025)
body:
- **Claim A:** the Casa BRUTUS web Q&A (MHJ-SRC-000277, MHJ-EV-00379) dates the first meeting,
  at which the editor gave her hard-to-find books, to 2024.
- **Claim B:** editor-in-chief Yoichi Nishio on radio (MHJ-SRC-000282, MHJ-EV-00385) says March
  2025, at Kaikai Kiki's Tokyo office, introduced by Murakami Takashi; InterFM's announcement
  (MHJ-SRC-000283) says 2025 (same broadcast; one unit).
- **Established:** they met before the months-long 2026 production; the introduction came through
  Murakami; the gift paired a 1960s–70s record book with an MF DOOM T-shirt.
- **Unknown:** which year is right; whether the Q&A's year refers to first contact rather than the
  meeting.
- **Candidate explanations:** translation or editing of the Q&A; first contact (2024) vs first
  meeting (2025); memory. The editor's account is more specific.
- **Affects the creative model?** No (it only dates a collaborator-trust anecdote).
- **Status:** open; the editor's March 2025 is the more specific account.

title: Vogue Korea, December 2024: credit wording
body:
- **Claim A:** allkpop says the shoot was directed by her ("director of the shoot";
  MHJ-SRC-000247, MHJ-EV-00524).
- **Claim B:** Kstyle (articleNo=2253109, 2024-12-18) says "special creative director".
- **Established:** NewJeans shared a Vogue Korea New Year shoot on 18 Dec 2024 crediting her; the
  members were presented by personal names. Dispute context (after her ADOR exit).
- **Unknown:** Vogue Korea's own credit (not checked; `coverage/source-gaps.md`).
- **Candidate explanations:** translation; one outlet compressing the credit.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes for wording: cite as "credited (wording varies)", not
  "she directed the Vogue shoot".
- **Status:** open.

---

## B. Attribution conflicts and myths

title: Chief visual director 박준영 credited above her (2009–2011)
body:
- **Claim A:** press and her self-accounts describe her as leading Girls' Generation, SHINee and
  f(x) visuals from *Gee* onward (MHJ-EV-00165, -00495; MHJ-SRC-000348 calls her 비주얼 디렉팅팀
  팀장 for *The Boys* costumes).
- **Claim B:** on every 2009–2011 record in the ledger (*Gee*, *Genie*, *Oh!*, *Hoot*, *The Boys*,
  *Nu ABO*, *Lucifer*; re-fetched for *Gee*, *Nu ABO*, *Lucifer*) 박준영 holds "Chief Director of
  Visual Producing" (Creative Director or Other) above her Art Direction / Visual Direction credits
  (MHJ-SRC-000296–000302, -000307; roles §1, §4.2). He also co-directs the *Mr.Mr.* MV (2014,
  with 손영, 전성진).
- **Established:** both are credited; a separately credited chief visual director sits above her on
  these releases; other designers (조아영, 권은정, 이병진, 홍은경) share art-direction credits.
- **Unknown:** the division of decisions between the two roles; booklets not checked (Discogs,
  "Needs Vote").
- **Candidate explanations:** a hierarchy in which she led the visual directing team under an
  executive-level visual producer; credit conventions listing seniority rather than authorship;
  her remit growing within that structure (MHJ-EV-00017, -00184).
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes. Principles drawn from 2009–2011 visual work must say she
  worked under a credited chief visual director; never "she directed *Gee*" without that.
- **Status:** resolved by record (the credits exist); division of labour open.

title: *Perfect Velvet* MV and teaser credits shared
body:
- **Claim A:** earlier summaries (roles.jsonl) gave her MV direction & arrangement and teaser
  planning & directing alone; a critic calls her the *Peek-A-Boo* visual director
  (MHJ-SRC-000365, MHJ-EV-00488).
- **Claim B:** the re-fetched record (MHJ-SRC-000318) shares MV direction & arrangement with 김예민
  and 김주영, credits 김지용 as Music Video Director, and shares teaser planning with 김예민; 이성수
  is Producing Director.
- **Established:** shared credits as listed (roles §1).
- **Unknown:** the record mixes digital and CD data; booklet unchecked.
- **Candidate explanations:** summariser compression; critics naming the best-known person.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes for wording: "co-directed with 김예민 and 김주영".
- **Status:** resolved by record.

title: *How Sweet* (2024): producer and vocal-direction credits shared
body:
- **Claim A:** she is credited Creative Director [Creative Supervisor], Executive-Producer,
  Producer [Album] and vocal direction (MHJ-SRC-000325).
- **Claim B:** the same record shares Producer [Album] with Keyon Kim and vocal direction with Keyon
  Kim, 장정우 and 조한나, and lists further Creative Director credits for Dana Kim, Hyerin Cho,
  Youngjun Jung, 김나연 and Yumi Choi (style).
- **Established:** shared credits as listed; 250 credited as producer/co-writer.
- **Unknown:** none material.
- **Candidate explanations:** "Creative Director" is a multi-person credit family at ADOR.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes for wording.
- **Status:** resolved by record.

title: SHINee *Dream Girl* (2013): two-chapter structure
body:
- **Claim A:** one report credits her with proposing the album theme "Misconceptions"
  (MHJ-EV-00053, medium); she explains the two chapters ("misconception about you / about me")
  in April 2013 (MHJ-EV-00056); Discogs: Art Direction [Visual & Art Director], Design
  (MHJ-SRC-000304, not re-verified).
- **Claim B:** at the 2013-02-14 preview SM producing head 이성수 presented the two chapters as one
  concept with linking puzzles across music, visuals and lyrics (MHJ-EV-00477).
- **Established:** she presented the visual concept as 실장; 이성수 presented the structure.
- **Unknown:** who originated the theme and the structure.
- **Candidate explanations:** joint development; each presenter speaking to his or her remit;
  the theme (hers per one report) and the release structure (presented by him) are different
  things.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: do not use *Dream Girl* as sole evidence of her
  "release-as-puzzle" structuring.
- **Status:** open.

title: *Ditto* / *OMG* / *ETA*: scenario and devices
body:
- **Claim A:** she explains the deer-in-a-snowfield image and its meaning (freedom vs the wish to
  possess) (MHJ-EV-00118, Cine21 Jan 2023 republished 2024); she cast an outsider director and
  describes herself as an "assistant director" (MHJ-EV-00119); she counter-proposed shooting the
  *ETA* video on the phone (MHJ-EV-00228).
- **Claim B:** director 신우석 says she offered one optional image and full authority (MHJ-EV-00447);
  the scenario and its devices (Hee-su, uniforms, camcorder) are his (MHJ-EV-00450); the corridor
  deer stands for the ideal friend and Circe's pigs seeded the scenario (MHJ-EV-00454); he wrote
  the *ETA* scenario (MHJ-EV-00527).
- **Established:** her documented inputs are the brief (purpose, one image), access to the members
  (MHJ-EV-00448), producer/vocal-direction credits, the phone-shot proposal (self-account) and the
  uniform type chosen after reading his script (MHJ-EV-00535). The narratives are his.
- **Unknown:** how the deer's meaning shifted between her image and his scenario.
- **Candidate explanations:** both accounts are true at different layers: brief vs scenario.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes. Supports "brief the purpose, leave the form" (strong, two
  sides agree); rules out crediting her with the MV narratives.
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent (brief layer vs scenario layer).

title: *Hype Boy* choreography: framing differs
body:
- **Claim A:** she says that when a first draft missed she re-explained and requested a full
  revision (MHJ-EV-00122).
- **Claim B:** performance director 김은주 says Min phoned to say she could take her time, that
  the chorus need not be a triangle formation, and suggested an easier take on a trendy style
  (MHJ-EV-00458).
- **Established:** a first draft was redone after her feedback; the choreography is Kim's work.
- **Unknown:** whether "full revision" and "take your time" describe the same call.
- **Candidate explanations:** same event told from the two sides; directive content, gentle
  delivery.
- **Affects the creative model?** Minor; supports a feedback-on-direction claim, not authorship.
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: HYBE logo: self-account vs no named CI designer
body:
- **Claim A:** she said in 2024 she made the HYBE logo (and the SM logo) and wrote HYBE's slogan,
  not the name (MHJ-EV-00326; dispute context, D=1).
- **Claim B:** HYBE says she oversaw (총괄) the corporate brand development; the 2021 presentation
  credits list her as Chief Creative Director with a named creative director, assistant director,
  planners and two outside studios for design, motion and 3D (MHJ-EV-00309); no source names the
  CI designers (roles header; source-gaps).
- **Established:** she oversaw the rebrand and explained the identity's reasoning in 2021
  (MHJ-EV-00311); she wrote the presentation's initial plan (MHJ-EV-00154).
- **Unknown:** who drew the logo.
- **Candidate explanations:** "made" used in the sense of directing; or personal authorship of the
  mark; the two are not distinguishable from current sources.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes for wording: "oversaw HYBE's rebrand"; logo authorship is a
  self-account.
- **Status:** open.

title: SM corporate identity: "directed" (2018) vs "made" (2024)
body:
- **Claim A:** 2018 Yonhap Q&A: she describes the SM identity she directed as a flexible identity
  (MHJ-EV-00006).
- **Claim B:** 2024 talk: she made the SM logo (MHJ-EV-00326, D=1) and made it flexible
  (MHJ-EV-00325, D=1).
- **Established:** a first-person account of directing SM's identity; no credit.
- **Unknown:** the designer of record.
- **Candidate explanations:** verb choice in speech vs print; directing and making used
  interchangeably.
- **Affects the creative model?** Minor; the "flexible identity" reasoning is first-person in a
  non-dispute source and can be used; authorship cannot.
- **Status:** open.

title: EXO planet premise vs EXO symbol
body:
- **Claim A:** design press (MHJ-EV-00164) and her accounts describe EXO's symbol as built from
  basic shapes to carry the exoplanet origin story (MHJ-EV-00186, -00509).
- **Claim B:** on a line the fan translator marked uncertain, the premise of superpowered boys from
  an EXO planet was producer 이수만's idea, which she found creative but potentially distant
  (MHJ-EV-00508, low). Her 2014 account says she judged the premise hard to make credible, so a
  symbol was needed (MHJ-EV-00186) — consistent with a premise she received.
- **Established:** the symbol system is her self-account (medium); there is no credit string for
  *MAMA*.
- **Unknown:** the premise's author.
- **Candidate explanations:** premise from the producer, visual system from her team.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: a principle about making a given premise credible through
  a symbol fits; one about inventing a group's lore does not.
- **Status:** open.

title: f(x) *Pink Tape* art film credits
body:
- **Claim A:** SM's release: planned by art director Min, directed and shot by 민제홍, 정우성 and
  이성은 with film students (MHJ-EV-00481); she says she proposed the film, styled the jacket and
  film herself, and chose a film student as director (MHJ-EV-00498, -00499, -00503).
- **Claim B:** Discogs lists 민제홍 and 정우성 under music-video credits (MHJ-SRC-000309), and lists
  her as Creative Director [Art Film] and stylist.
- **Established:** planning and styling are hers; filming and direction belong to the named
  students.
- **Unknown:** booklet credits; the reported KRW 5 million budget (MHJ-EV-00032, medium) has a
  namu.wiki origin.
- **Candidate explanations:** database categorisation.
- **Affects the creative model?** Minor (wording: "planned").
- **Status:** open.

title: V *Layover* (2023): role wording
body:
- **Claim A:** NME headline "creative director"; Big Hit: she would lead music, choreography and
  promotion style (MHJ-EV-00460); Korean reports "총괄 프로듀서"; Discogs "Producer".
- **Claim B:** V says they made it together and chose the title together, and his proposed ideas
  were taken up (MHJ-EV-00462, -00463).
- **Established:** a producer role with joint decisions on title and direction.
- **Unknown:** credit booklet.
- **Candidate explanations:** label, outlet and artist describe one collaboration at different
  levels.
- **Affects the creative model?** Minor.
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: Myth: "she created everything at SM"
body:
- **Claim A:** 2019 headlines such as "소녀시대 콘셉트 만든 민희진" (MHJ-SRC-000048); a critic's
  "SM's Midas touch" framing (MHJ-EV-00489); her own statement that SM's approach to visuals was
  reorganised around her method over about ten years (MHJ-EV-00136).
- **Claim B:** credits show a chief visual director above her in 2009–2011 (CX-08), shared design
  and MV credits throughout (roles §2), MVs by other directors (MHJ-EV-00190: separate team from
  late 2014; other directors handled acts she was not on), her account of being refused styling
  authority early and at times losing MV authority (MHJ-EV-00322, D=1), Girls' Generation's debut
  proposal made "though not yet in overall charge" (MHJ-EV-00184), a critic's "and others" for
  f(x) (MHJ-EV-00482), and her credit to colleague 김예민 (MHJ-EV-00155).
- **Established:** she led SM's visual & art directing function and widened it over time; she did
  not author SM's music, choreography or every act's visuals.
- **Unknown:** per-release division of labour before 2012.
- **Candidate explanations:** praise compression; her visibility after 2019; the team leader
  receiving credit for team output (she names this herself, MHJ-EV-00134).
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: SM-era principles are "directed a team" principles.
- **Status:** resolved by record (myth rejected).

title: Myth: "she makes NewJeans' music"
body:
- **Claim A:** popular framing of NewJeans' sound as hers; her description of the debut as
  publishing her personal playlist (MHJ-EV-00222).
- **Claim B:** she is not a songwriter and holds no copyright (MHJ-EV-00109); songs come from
  composers, beat-makers and top-liners; she collects demos, decides, and refines mixing,
  mastering and vocal direction with a long-time producer partner (MHJ-EV-00111, -00113); credits
  name 250, FRNK, Frankie Scoca, Erika de Casier and others (roles §2); vocal direction is shared
  (CX-10).
- **Established:** selection, sequencing and finishing direction are hers; composition is not.
- **Unknown:** per-track A&R detail; BANA's role (see CX-46).
- **Candidate explanations:** "producer" read in its songwriting sense; she herself calls "she
  picked songs" both right and wrong (MHJ-EV-00113).
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: music principles concern curation and finishing, not
  writing.
- **Status:** resolved by record (myth rejected).

title: Myth: "Y2K / retro is her method"
body:
- **Claim A:** reception of NewJeans as Y2K or retro; a member recalls her explaining that things
  once fashionable come back (MHJ-EV-00455, written answers via the agency).
- **Claim B:** she denies targeting retro (MHJ-EV-00219, 2022; MHJ-EV-00537, 2024 NHK 9:22–10:20:
  people are drawn to universal things, only the expression changes); she says a broad style such
  as Y2K belongs to no one (MHJ-EV-00583, D=1); she found late-1990s–early-2000s design awkward
  when young (MHJ-EV-00295); her stated targets are timelessness and a childhood "treasure box"
  (MHJ-EV-00085).
- **Established:** a recurring period look is an output; her stated method targets a universal
  feeling.
- **Unknown:** none needed.
- **Candidate explanations:** observers read method from surface; the members' age-appropriate
  styling coincided with a trend cycle (MHJ-EV-00219 calls trends a Möbius strip).
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: never a rule (SYNTHESIS_BRIEF hard rule). See CX-24 for the
  real tension inside her reasoning.
- **Status:** resolved by record (myth rejected).

title: Who originated and cast NewJeans
body:
- **Claim A:** 2022: auditions in September 2019, casting completed by end-2019, about two years of
  training, planned as a joint project for 2021 (MHJ-EV-00142); she took over the project in
  September 2021 (MHJ-EV-00146); she collected demos from around 2019 (MHJ-EV-00222). 2024
  (D=1): the original set-up split work three ways — her creative direction, the chairman's music,
  Source Music's management (MHJ-EV-00557); only one existing trainee was selectable; Hanni came
  through an audition she branded (MHJ-EV-00558, -00559).
- **Claim B:** Bang Si-hyuk in August 2020 framed the group as prepared with CBO Min and Source
  Music (MHJ-SRC-000056, quarantine); HYBE's 2021 ADOR release names members chosen in the 2019
  Plus Global Audition (MHJ-EV-00521); Source Music sued her over statements about the group's
  origins (MHJ-SRC-000405, headline only; no ruling).
- **Established:** a 2019 audition; a joint project under Source Music before ADOR; transfer to
  ADOR in 2021; debut 2022-07-22.
- **Unknown:** which members were recruited and trained by whom; terms of the original
  arrangement.
- **Candidate explanations:** "creating a group" covers casting, training and concept, which
  different parties led at different times.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: casting principles (MHJ-EV-00541) may cite her stated
  criteria but not claim she cast all members.
- **Status:** open (litigation pending).

title: Myth: NewJeans' result = her planning alone, or = HYBE capital
body:
- **Claim A:** she rejects the "HYBE capital" framing: strategy was the label's, budget not
  unusually large, video budgets below average (MHJ-EV-00096, -00097; -00579, D=1).
- **Claim B:** a 2026 critic notes the industry has long debated planning vs HYBE's capital and
  system, and calls OOAK a test without them (MHJ-EV-00345); her own 2024 market reasoning counts
  on curiosity attached to her name (MHJ-EV-00404) and advertisers through her relationships
  (MHJ-EV-00568, D=1).
- **Established:** HYBE invested; ADOR set strategy; budget figures are her claims.
- **Unknown:** budgets; counterfactuals.
- **Candidate explanations:** both factors; neither is measurable from public sources.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: cost-efficiency principles must carry "her account, inside
  a funded label".
- **Status:** open (OOAK's results may later bear on it).

---

## C. Tensions in her own reasoning

title: Retro rejected as a target vs nostalgia chosen for a record
body:
- **Claim A:** retro is not a target; people are drawn to universal things and only the expression
  changes (MHJ-SRC-000269, 9:22–10:20, MHJ-EV-00537; also MHJ-EV-00219, -00085).
- **Claim B:** choosing a flute interlude over a piano version, she worried it sounded old-fashioned
  but chose it because it was more nostalgic and fit the record's direction (MHJ-SRC-000418, edit 1,
  1:08:41–1:10:35, MHJ-EV-00433); a member recalls her saying past styles return
  (MHJ-EV-00455); period specifics are researched to the detail for a 1980s cover stage
  (MHJ-EV-00602, D=1); OOAK's launch imagery draws on childhood record shops (MHJ-EV-00550).
- **Established:** she uses period material as a means inside a direction set elsewhere; she
  rejects it as the end.
- **Unknown:** how the record's "nostalgic direction" was itself set.
- **Candidate explanations:** target vs ingredient (her own Möbius-strip framing,
  MHJ-EV-00219); "nostalgic" as a feeling (universal) vs "retro" as a style (period); context of a
  specific record.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: a "target the universal feeling, not period style"
  principle needs the caveat that period material is used as an ingredient when it serves the
  feeling.
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: Producing–management integration: insisted on vs "not universal"
body:
- **Claim A:** creation and capital are inseparable; she became CEO to exist as a creator
  (MHJ-EV-00140, 2022); production and management must run as one organism (MHJ-EV-00090,
  2024-02); creative authority and budget belong together (MHJ-EV-00095, Jan 2023); producing and
  management must not be separated (MHJ-EV-00568, -00586, D=1).
- **Claim B:** the same month as the dispute-era statements, outside an adversarial setting, she
  says integration is not universally better; some people do better with the two separated; it is
  that she needs to do it all (MHJ-SRC-000418, edit 1, 1:12:35–1:13:29, MHJ-EV-00436).
- **Established:** the view is first-person, repeated across 2022–2024, and qualified by her.
- **Unknown:** whether the caveat appears before 2024.
- **Candidate explanations:** a personal operating need generalised in argument and particularised
  in reflection; audience and setting.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: the integration principle must be framed as "fit the
  structure to the person" (MHJ-EV-00436's own application), not as a universal rule.
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: Fans as friends vs the need to sell
body:
- **Claim A:** fans are genuine friends — the fan name gives them the members' species
  (MHJ-EV-00227); the public as friends or classmates (MHJ-EV-00291); maximum closeness, no
  managed distance (MHJ-EV-00141); Phoning built on a crew-like relationship (MHJ-EV-00523).
- **Claim B:** "selling to the fandom" felt odd, yet business needs money to reproduce
  (MHJ-EV-00420); earning from people who like you can feel uncomfortable (MHJ-EV-00581, D=1); it
  mattered that NewJeans made money so aesthetics get attention (MHJ-EV-00321, D=1); popular art
  is not free of numbers (MHJ-EV-00098).
- **Established:** she names the tension herself and answers it with density of quality ("no dud
  for a fan picking blindly") and keepsake goods (MHJ-EV-00392).
- **Unknown:** pricing and product decisions beyond her accounts.
- **Candidate explanations:** a stated reconciliation (give many good things → voluntary
  virtuous cycle), which she calls idealistic; her stance also shifted toward serving fans more
  kindly (MHJ-EV-00298, 2026).
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: a "treat the audience as friends" principle must carry her
  own commercial counterweight.
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent (she supplies the condition).

title: No random photocards (2023) vs random version packing (2024)
body:
- **Claim A:** NewJeans albums did not include randomised photocards; she wanted purchases from
  genuine feeling and ran no paid YouTube promotion (MHJ-EV-00102; Cine21 Jan 2023, republished
  2024-04-24).
- **Claim B:** at the 2024-04-25 press conference she says she dislikes random packing but uses it,
  because fixed member versions would expose members' relative popularity (MHJ-EV-00566, D=1,
  namu transcript not checked against the recording); the same conference criticises random-photocard tactics
  (MHJ-EV-00567, D=1).
- **Established:** both are her statements; one is about photocards, the other about which member
  version is in a box.
- **Unknown:** the actual packaging of each release; whether policy changed between 2023 and 2024.
- **Candidate explanations:** different mechanics; a policy change; transcript error.
- **Affects the creative model?** Minor: an "earn demand without growth hacks" principle should
  cite the photocard case only.
- **Status:** open.

title: Naturalness as strength vs "cannot be a concept" vs a designed debut
body:
- **Claim A:** naturalness is the difference from conventional K-pop, but it cannot be staged or
  made a concept; it comes from the environment off camera (MHJ-EV-00539; also MHJ-EV-00224,
  -00088, -00089).
- **Claim B:** the debut was intensively designed: members drastically restyled per video to
  confuse identification (MHJ-EV-00235), a "picture of five" designed down to sound and movement
  (MHJ-EV-00330, D=1), the whole experience designed with the content (MHJ-EV-00532).
- **Established:** she distinguishes designing conditions and presentation from designing the
  members' behaviour.
- **Unknown:** how members experienced the line between the two (member accounts: MHJ-EV-00456).
- **Candidate explanations:** the method designs the frame and the environment and leaves the
  behaviour; "naturalness" is an outcome claim, not an observable.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: state it as "design the conditions, not the authenticity";
  do not claim naturalness as a demonstrated output.
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: Withholding / curiosity vs dislike of push-and-pull and hard selling
body:
- **Claim A:** concealment drives curiosity (MHJ-EV-00531); names withheld and members restyled so
  fans keep "studying" (MHJ-EV-00235); strict secrecy before debut (MHJ-EV-00290); she does not
  pitch but makes people curious (MHJ-EV-00597, D=1); OOAK's easter-egg launch (MHJ-EV-00340).
- **Claim B:** she has never intended push-and-pull and prefers honesty and kindness
  (MHJ-EV-00141); she is decisive and dislikes push-and-pull (MHJ-EV-00405); the "hidden real" is
  not withholding as a game (MHJ-EV-00213); over-hyping sets up disappointment (MHJ-EV-00271).
- **Established:** both are stated; Claim B concerns relationships and work decisions, Claim A
  concerns release sequencing.
- **Unknown:** none.
- **Candidate explanations:** curiosity about the work vs manipulation of the relationship;
  withholding information vs withholding affection; her stated rule that people should be able to
  enjoy the work without decoding it (MHJ-EV-00213).
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: a curiosity principle must say "withhold information, not
  value; the work must stand without the puzzle".
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: Total involvement vs entrusting specialists
body:
- **Claim A:** involved down to chairs and lights (MHJ-EV-00214); reviews everything A to Z
  (MHJ-EV-00566, D=1); still makes new, hard-to-explain things herself (MHJ-EV-00103); shot
  teasers herself because the concept was hard to transmit (MHJ-EV-00171, -00180); attends to
  almost every part (MHJ-EV-00276); dislikes interference in setting direction (MHJ-EV-00603, D=1).
- **Claim B:** first rule is not to touch what a skilled person is skilled at (MHJ-EV-00276);
  "assistant director" to an outside MV director (MHJ-EV-00119); entrusts the Tokyo Dome crew
  after explaining intent (MHJ-EV-00393); cannot set moves, only feel and direction
  (MHJ-EV-00122); collaborators confirm freedom (MHJ-EV-00447, -00526).
- **Established:** she reconciles it herself: micromanagement is neither good nor bad
  (MHJ-EV-00123); meticulousness is selective (MHJ-EV-00585, D=1); she pinches only the missed
  points to keep each worker's individuality (MHJ-EV-00421).
- **Unknown:** collaborator accounts critical of over-involvement (none located; absence is not
  evidence).
- **Candidate explanations:** control of purpose and finish, freedom in the specialist's method;
  degree varies with the person and the novelty of the task.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: state the condition (novel / hard-to-explain → do it
  yourself; specialist craft → brief and leave).
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: Visual first (2013–2018) vs music first (2022–2026)
body:
- **Claim A:** she joined SM as a design graduate interested in record covers (MHJ-EV-00001, 2018);
  SM's music was far from her taste (MHJ-EV-00013, 2013); creative direction is giving visual form
  to music (MHJ-EV-00003); visuals are effectively equal to music in K-pop (MHJ-EV-00007, 2018).
- **Claim B:** she wanted a label solely for the music (MHJ-EV-00237, 2022); she entered
  entertainment to release the music she wants, art direction was the bridge and visuals are
  auxiliary to music (MHJ-EV-00307, 2026); "concept" is wrongly treated as visual (MHJ-EV-00236).
- **Established:** the role widened from visual to whole production (MHJ-EV-00217 lists the path);
  she gave opinions on music at SM (MHJ-EV-00152, -00215).
- **Unknown:** whether the 2026 framing describes her original intent or a later re-reading.
- **Candidate explanations:** retrospective reframing after the role changed; consistent
  underlying view that the parts interlock (MHJ-EV-00153 says not because music matters most);
  audience (film venue in 2026).
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: do not state a fixed hierarchy of music over visuals; the
  stable view is interlock (MHJ-EV-00090, -00153).
- **Status:** open (a change over time, not settled by the record).

title: Anti-lore stance vs symbol systems and story arcs
body:
- **Claim A:** strong antipathy to K-pop "worldview" systems; NewJeans has none (MHJ-EV-00116);
  she does not use the word and prefers natural flow to constructed settings (MHJ-EV-00125).
- **Claim B:** EXO's symbol was built to make a premise credible and grow the story
  (MHJ-EV-00186); f(x) releases unfold as a story (MHJ-EV-00175); OOAK's launch speaks in
  fragments of a fictional world and promises an epic-like record of a group's birth
  (MHJ-EV-00339, -00343, label/B).
- **Established:** she distinguishes a fixed constructed setting from continuity across releases
  (MHJ-EV-00175 says "without a fixed lore"); method chosen per act (MHJ-EV-00168).
- **Unknown:** OOAK's eventual narrative approach.
- **Candidate explanations:** per-act choice; label copy vs her own words; continuity vs lore.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: "no lore" is not a universal rule; the rule is "choose the
  system per act; prefer continuity to fixed settings".
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: "Slightly unfriendly is good" (2014) vs "remove every burden" (2023)
body:
- **Claim A:** meaningful work that is slightly unfriendly is good; easy things tire quickly
  (MHJ-EV-00037, 2014); try something minor in the most major place (MHJ-EV-00173); not too easy
  (MHJ-EV-00169).
- **Claim B:** NewJeans' tentative explanation is a return to basics, vocals with every burdensome
  element removed, pleasant anywhere (MHJ-EV-00115); intuitive work is decoded instinctively
  (MHJ-EV-00426).
- **Established:** both target a work that is easy to receive and has depth on decoding
  (MHJ-EV-00023, 2013: a tightrope between the centre and the gap).
- **Unknown:** none.
- **Candidate explanations:** different acts and goals (f(x) differentiation vs a mass launch);
  surface ease vs structural depth (her scratch-art image, MHJ-EV-00305).
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: calibrate difficulty to the act; the stable element is "easy
  surface, layered depth".
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: Does not analyse the market vs explicit market analysis
body:
- **Claim A:** she does not deliberately analyse the market; signals already visible slow you down
  (MHJ-EV-00093, 2024-02).
- **Claim B:** the debut budget was planned from experience and market research (MHJ-EV-00097);
  she gives an explicit audience-widening analysis for NewJeans (MHJ-EV-00404); she sees what is
  missing in the market (MHJ-EV-00334).
- **Established:** she separates trend-signal analysis (rejected) from positioning and budgeting
  (used).
- **Unknown:** none.
- **Candidate explanations:** two meanings of "market analysis".
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: phrase as "do not derive direction from visible trend data;
  do position and budget deliberately".
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: Out of the spotlight vs her name as launch asset
body:
- **Claim A:** declined TV and advertising offers at SM (MHJ-EV-00132, -00376); avoided cameras so
  artists stay the protagonists (MHJ-EV-00243); accepted only written interviews early
  (MHJ-EV-00248).
- **Claim B:** "Min Hee-jin's girl group" used to brand scouting (MHJ-EV-00559, D=1); a TV talk
  show to front the launch (MHJ-EV-00561, D=1); K-pop fans would look because of her name
  (MHJ-EV-00404); media appearances before launch (MHJ-EV-00250).
- **Established:** she gives the reason for the change: to cushion the rebound against something
  new by giving the planner's context (MHJ-EV-00250); OOAK no longer needs it (MHJ-EV-00251).
- **Unknown:** none.
- **Candidate explanations:** a deliberate switch when her role became label head.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: "keep the maker invisible" is conditional; visibility is
  used to frame unfamiliar work.
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: Teasers: calculated craft (2014) vs empty custom (2022)
body:
- **Claim A:** each teaser's timing and order is calculated; thirteen teasers in a day for
  *Red Light* (MHJ-EV-00170, -00172).
- **Claim B:** teasers had become a mere custom and were skipped for NewJeans' debut
  (MHJ-EV-00234, -00218); the second EP led with a teaser for the last track (MHJ-EV-00533).
- **Established:** the stable rule is sequencing for a desired reaction; the teaser is optional.
- **Unknown:** none.
- **Candidate explanations:** attention level differs (unknown debut with high curiosity vs an
  established act).
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: write the principle as sequencing, not as a format.
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: Youth audience as purpose vs "no age-targeting"
body:
- **Claim A:** her stated purpose includes showing good artwork to teenagers and people in their
  twenties (MHJ-EV-00258, -00169, -00377).
- **Claim B:** OOAK will not lean on age-targeted marketing (MHJ-EV-00373, 2026); NewJeans aimed
  to widen across generations (MHJ-EV-00404).
- **Established:** both stated.
- **Unknown:** OOAK's practice.
- **Candidate explanations:** cultural purpose (who should be served) vs marketing segmentation
  (how to sell).
- **Affects the creative model?** Minor.
- **Status:** open.

title: Boy group first as her "usual order" vs the record
body:
- **Claim A:** a boy group first, then perhaps a girl group, is her usual order (MHJ-EV-00333,
  2025-12).
- **Claim B:** at SM, Girls' Generation's debut (2007) preceded SHINee (2008); at HYBE her assignment
  and ADOR's first act were a girl group, which she judged more advantageous for widening the
  audience (MHJ-EV-00202, -00404).
- **Established:** SM sequence GG 2007 → SHINee 2008 → f(x) 2009 → EXO 2012 → Red Velvet 2014.
- **Unknown:** what "usual order" refers to (her own involvement from formation: SHINee 2008 before
  f(x) 2009; EXO 2012 before Red Velvet 2014).
- **Candidate explanations:** she counts acts conceived from formation, not Girls' Generation
  (where she joined after naming, MHJ-EV-00017).
- **Affects the creative model?** No.
- **Status:** open.

## D. Dispute-era framing vs pre-dispute statements (same professional topic)

Dates compared only; the dispute itself is not judged. Pre-dispute = before 2024-04-22.

title: Producing–management integration
body:
- **Claim A (pre-dispute):** 2022-03 creation and capital inseparable (MHJ-EV-00140); 2022-04 all
  areas interlock (MHJ-EV-00153); Jan 2023 creative authority with budget (MHJ-EV-00095);
  2024-02 one organism (MHJ-EV-00090).
- **Claim B (dispute era):** a producer-only role shows ignorance of the business; work loses
  meaning once split (MHJ-EV-00586, 2024-09-27); a "professional manager" for producing is
  rejected (MHJ-EV-00572, 2024-05-31); integration made NewJeans possible (MHJ-EV-00316, 2024-09-26).
- **Established:** the view predates the dispute by at least two years; the dispute-era wording is
  more absolute; a non-adversarial caveat follows the same month (CX-25).
- **Unknown:** none.
- **Candidate explanations:** the position became the subject of the dispute (her CEO removal was
  justified by separating production and management, MHJ-SRC-000146), so statements hardened.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: cite pre-dispute units for the principle; dispute units
  only as repetition; generalizability medium for dispute units.
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: "System": balanced (2013–2022) vs "a disease" (2024)
body:
- **Claim A (pre-dispute):** once an attempt succeeds it becomes systematised (MHJ-EV-00493,
  2013); SM is more human than "music factory" suggests (MHJ-EV-00026, 2013); systems bring
  efficiency, stability and capital but drift toward loss of individuality, so she wanted to break
  the system while preserving it (MHJ-EV-00130, 2022).
- **Claim B (dispute era):** a system is what owners build to direct employees easily; factory
  systems are a disease in entertainment (MHJ-EV-00587, -00600, 2024-09); impressive-sounding
  systems can be empty wordplay (MHJ-EV-00320, D=1).
- **Established:** a long-held ambivalence; the one-sided framing appears in 2024.
- **Unknown:** whether "system" means the same thing in both (organisational process vs industry
  production model).
- **Candidate explanations:** different referents; adversarial setting; experience at HYBE.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: use the 2022 "break while preserving" balance as the
  principle; mark the 2024 statements as dispute context.
- **Status:** open.

title: Copying and formula: the view predates the dispute
body:
- **Claim A (pre-dispute):** in a saturated market anything new is mass-reproduced until it is
  unclear who did it first (MHJ-EV-00011, 2018); multiplying similar entities in a limited market
  is foolish (MHJ-EV-00193, 2015); hit formulas are repeated until styles converge
  (MHJ-EV-00086, Jan 2024).
- **Claim B (dispute era):** surface elements are shared, whole production formulas are not
  (MHJ-EV-00564, -00565); there is a threshold of borrowing density (MHJ-EV-00584); Y2K belongs to no
  one (MHJ-EV-00583); she frames her 2024 objection as creative ethics (MHJ-EV-00350, 2026).
- **Established:** the convergence critique is pre-dispute; the formula/element distinction is
  articulated in the dispute.
- **Unknown:** whether any specific case met her threshold (litigation; not judged; see CX-46).
- **Candidate explanations:** a general view applied to a specific case under pressure.
- **Affects the creative model?** Yes: the "do not copy a formula; recombine elements through your
  own reasoning" principle may use pre-dispute units (plus MHJ-EV-00197, -00425 on not copying
  references); the threshold idea stays medium.
- **Status:** reconciled as context-dependent.

title: Seven-year contract: schooling (2024) vs shorter terms (2025)
body:
- **Claim A:** she likened the seven-year contract to high school plus university
  (MHJ-EV-00540, 2024-02, pre-dispute); members should use the seven years to learn independence
  (MHJ-EV-00577, D=1); she drew a seven-year plan (MHJ-EV-00596, D=1).
- **Claim B:** she proposes contracts much shorter than the customary seven years and a revised
  standard form (MHJ-EV-00331, 2025-12, D=1); people should work together because they need each
  other (MHJ-EV-00332).
- **Established:** a change of position between 2024 and 2025.
- **Unknown:** OOAK's actual terms; a trade critic notes investors must be persuaded
  (MHJ-EV-00346).
- **Candidate explanations:** experience of the dispute; a new company's model; working within an
  existing norm vs proposing a new one.
- **Affects the creative model?** Minor (organisation domain).
- **Status:** open.

title: HYBE HQ open plan: her reasoning (2021) vs requested by others (2024)
body:
- **Claim A:** the 2021 presentation presents free seating, movable racks and "come together, not
  placed together" as function-led reasoning (MHJ-EV-00312, -00314, -00520); the architects claim
  the grid and racks as their design reasoning (MHJ-EV-00516).
- **Claim B:** in 2024 she says that as a designer she preferred private partitioned spaces, an open
  plan was requested, and she added moving racks to screen desks (MHJ-EV-00608, D=1, low — fan
  transcript).
- **Established:** the HQ was a group design (SPACE credits); the rack system existed.
- **Unknown:** who requested open plan; the passage is unverified against the recording.
- **Candidate explanations:** a brief accepted and then argued for in the presentation; three
  parties describing one design; transcript error.
- **Affects the creative model?** Minor: do not cite the HQ as evidence of her preference for open
  plan; cite it for "space shapes attitude" (MHJ-EV-00203, pre-dispute).
- **Status:** open.

title: Label autonomy: accepted difference (2022) vs dispute-era account
body:
- **Claim A:** 2022: HYBE's leadership accepted that her approach differed, and coexisting
  possibilities raise the chance of success (MHJ-EV-00139); she was given three tasks on joining
  (MHJ-EV-00202, 2021).
- **Claim B:** 2024 (D=1): she initially resisted a shared set-up (MHJ-EV-00557); multi-label groups
  need labels to differ and the top decision-maker to stay above them (MHJ-EV-00562, -00563).
- **Established:** both are her statements at different dates.
- **Unknown:** everything about internal decisions (out of scope).
- **Candidate explanations:** relationships change; the 2024 statements are adversarial.
- **Affects the creative model?** No (governance; record only).
- **Status:** open.

## E. Dispute record and criticism (quarantine)

Recorded for dated facts and myth prevention only (from
`coverage/discovery/secondary-contradiction.contradictions.jsonl`). No merits are assessed.
